introduction: New York weatherization improves efficiency in eligible homes through local providers. Renters and homeowners can apply.
description: New York weatherization improves efficiency in eligible homes through local providers. Renters and homeowners can apply.

sections.who: Income eligibility and property rules apply. Seniors, families with children and disabled people receive priority. Some existing benefits establish eligibility.
sections.get: An audit identifies suitable measures. Services are free to eligible homeowners and renters; rental-building owners contribute.

sections.apply:
1. Find the county provider

    Use HCR’s provider directory.

  2. Apply locally

    Confirm required records and permission arrangements.

  3. Arrange assessment

    After the audit, the provider selects and completes eligible work.
sections.after: A final inspection checks quality. Ask about waiting times.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using New York WAP applicant guide. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Eligible renters receive services at no cost.
